key_findings: SNI induced hippocampal neuroinflammation and cognitive dysfunction in male mice; males were more susceptible than females.
Estrogen supplementation improved cognitive function in SNI male mice, while estrogen receptor inhibition in female SNI mice caused neuroinflammation and cognitive impairment.
Hippocampal estrogen content negatively correlated with microglia number.
Chemogenetic inhibition of hippocampal PV interneuron excitability rescued SNI-induced cognitive impairment.
Estrogen acts by suppressing the neuroinflammation-mediated increase in PV interneuron excitability.
